{"parentUuid":"ecfa8c8c-81cd-4163-bd38-cb01ed049a2b","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"5ddc41b3-3f0f-4d1d-ad4d-51da1bb60ecf","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01XSn9v1jcHLmMwNbnfstejk","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t---\n2\tstatus: PROPOSAL — AMENDMENT to existing agent-workspace/constitution/financial-data-protocol.md\n3\tproposed_at: 2026-04-30\n4\tproposed_by: Claude Opus 4.7 (S26 IMPL — Phase 1 Track B; master-plan 004 § S26 deliverable #1)\n5\tsource_evidence:\n6\t  - PROJECT_CHARTER.md § First Sub-Scope (HOSE/HNX/UPCoM, vốn hóa 2,000-50,000 tỷ VND, position sizing 5-15%, holding 1m-24m)\n7\t  - agent-workspace/ubiquitous-language/glossary.md v1.0 (S25 deliverable; 42 VN terms incl. T+2.5, Room ngoại, Sàn HOSE/HNX/UPCoM, Trần, Sàn, Phiên ATO/ATC, Tỷ giá USD/VND)\n8\t  - specs/tier2-feature/000-phase-1-thin-slice-VHM.md § A.3 BR-3 + BR-5 (T+2.5 informational; VND only Phase 1)\n9\t  - agent-workspace/constitution/financial-data-protocol.md Rules 1-10 (existing baseline; this amendment APPENDS Rules 12-15 — Rule 11 reserved for S16 amendment Hook Portability)\n10\t  - docs/DAY_1_CHECKLIST.md § A.4 + § B.1 (financial-data-protocol customization step)\n11\ttarget_constitution_path: agent-workspace/constitution/financial-data-protocol.md\n12\ttarget_section: NEW § \"Vietnam-Domain Rules 12-15\"\n13\tmove_when: user explicit approve; insertion point = after \"## Rule 10: Backtest Reproducibility\" and before \"## Quick Reference Table\"\n14\trelates_to:\n15\t  - financial-data-protocol-amendment.md (S16 — Rule 11 Hook Portability; ORTHOGONAL to this amendment, NOT a fold)\n16\t  - invariants-amendment-VN.md (S26 sibling — I-S55-I-S65 invariants enforce these Rules)\n17\t---\n18\t\n19\t# Financial Data Protocol Amendment — Vietnam-Domain Rules 12-15\n20\t\n21\t> **Status**: PROPOSAL pending user approve. Codifies VN-specific data integrity rules that emerged from glossary v1.0 (S25) and Phase 1 thin-slice spec (S25). Each Rule names existing glossary terms by exact spelling and references invariants-amendment-VN.md for enforcement.\n22\t>\n23\t> **Why these Rules and not others**: glossary v1.0 surfaced 8 critical VN-domain terms (T+2.5, Room ngoại, Đội lái, Mua chủ động, Bán chủ động, Sàn HOSE/HNX/UPCoM, Phiên ATO/ATC, Tỷ giá USD/VND). Rules 12-15 cover the 4 that are data-integrity-binding for Phase 1+ (settlement timing, foreign-cap detection, sàn-tier data quality, FX point-in-time). Đội lái + Mua/Bán chủ động + ATO/ATC are Phase 2+ (intraday + Tier 4 work) — deferred.\n24\t\n25\t## Append to `financial-data-protocol.md` (NEW section, after Rule 10)\n26\t\n27\t---\n28\t\n29\t## Rule 12 — T+2.5 Settlement Timing Awareness\n30\t\n31\t### The Problem\n32\t\n33\tVN equities settle T+2.5 (trade date + 2.5 trading days). A buy on Monday clears Wednesday afternoon; cash from a Monday sell is re-investable Wednesday afternoon. Backtests that ignore T+2.5 over-count compoundable cash by 2-3 trading days, producing false-positive performance especially for high-turnover strategies.\n34\t\n35\t### The Rule\n36\t\n37\t- Every `Position` entity tracks `opened_at` = trade-match date (NOT cleared-cash date).\n38\t- Every cash-flow record carries `cleared_at = opened_at + T+2.5 trading days` (computed via VN trading calendar, not naive +3 calendar days).\n39\t- Backtest re-investment available cash queries: `WHERE cleared_at <= action_date`.\n40\t- Live cash queries may use `cleared_at <= today` for pre-trade checks; cash gating in `apps/cli/order_*.py` (Phase 2+) MUST consult cleared cash, not trade-match cash.\n41\t- Phase 1 thin-slice exception: `Position.opened_at` is required, but T+2.5 cash gating is NOT enforced (deferred to Phase 2 when intraday/order-management lands per spec 000 § BR-5).\n42\t\n43\t### The Enforcement\n44\t\n45\t`PositionRepository.compute_cleared_cash(as_of_date)` is the only path for re-investable cash. No `available_cash()` method bypasses T+2.5. CI gate (Phase 2+) adds property test: random portfolio + random sell timing, assert `cleared_at - opened_at` always ≥2.5 trading days per VN calendar.\n46\t\n47\t---\n48\t\n49\t## Rule 13 — Room Ngoại (Foreign-Ownership Cap) Detection\n50\t\n51\t### The Problem\n52\t\n53\tForeign investors face a hard ceiling on per-stock ownership in VN equities. The cap is sector-dependent: banking ≤30%, real estate ≤49%, most industrial ≤49% with stock-specific overrides. When a stock saturates Room ngoại, foreign buy-pressure cannot accumulate further — the stock is effectively closed to foreign-flow signal until domestic holders sell to foreigners. Strategies that key on \"foreign accumulation\" silently fail on saturated stocks. Strategies that pump on \"Room ngoại near full\" (early signal of further foreign demand) miss the regime.\n54\t\n55\t### The Rule\n56\t\n57\t- Every `Bar` (BC-1) carries `foreign_buy_volume` + `foreign_sell_volume` (existing schema per architecture.md BC-1).\n58\t- NEW per-Ticker daily snapshot record `ForeignOwnershipState`: `(ticker, date, foreign_owned_shares, foreign_cap_shares, saturation_pct, source_provider, ingested_at, as_of)`.\n59\t- `saturation_pct = foreign_owned_shares / foreign_cap_shares`. When `saturation_pct >= 0.95`, the stock is in saturation regime — foreign-flow analysis must explicitly mark this.\n60\t- Source provenance: HOSE listed-stocks portal + vnstock `room_ngoai()` endpoint + TCBS reconciliation per Rule 4. Rule 4 reconciliation tolerance = 1% of cap (NOT 1% of saturation_pct — different denominators).\n61\t- Backtest queries on foreign accumulation MUST filter `WHERE saturation_pct < 0.95 OR explicit_saturation_strategy = TRUE`.\n62\t\n63\t### The Enforcement\n64\t\n65\t`ForeignOwnershipRepository` Protocol: `get_state_as_of(ticker, as_of_date)` + `get_saturated_universe(as_of_date, threshold=0.95)`. Bar+ForeignOwnership join in `MarketDataReadModel` denormalized view. Phase 1 thin-slice on VHM does NOT seed ForeignOwnership data (Phase 2 deliverable when full VN30 ingestion lands); Bar.foreign_buy / foreign_sell fields are seeded but Saturation analysis deferred.\n66\t\n67\t---\n68\t\n69\t## Rule 14 — Sàn HOSE / HNX / UPCoM Data-Quality Tiering\n70\t\n71\t### The Problem\n72\t\n73\tVN listed equities split across 3 exchanges (Sàn): HOSE (HCMC; tier-1 large caps; strictest disclosure), HNX (Hanoi; tier-2; mid-caps), UPCoM (over-the-counter board; tier-3; micro-caps + pre-listing transitional). Data quality, filing cadence, and cross-source reconciliation tolerance differ by Sàn. Treating UPCoM Bars with the same trust as HOSE Bars produces false-positive backtest signals on noisy UPCoM data.\n74\t\n75\t### The Rule\n76\t\n77\t- Every `Ticker` value object infers Sàn at construction (regex on listing-status feed: 3-letter alpha → HOSE; 3-letter alpha + HNX flag → HNX; UPCoM has explicit ticker namespace).\n78\t- Every `Bar` carries `sàn` field (NEW; values: HOSE | HNX | UPCoM). Field is denormalized from Ticker for query performance (Rule 4 reconciliation runs per-Sàn).\n79\t- Reconciliation tolerance per Rule 4 is Sàn-tiered:\n80\t  - HOSE: ±1% (existing tolerance preserved)\n81\t  - HNX: ±2% (mid-cap, slightly noisier filings)\n82\t  - UPCoM: ±5% (micro-cap, frequent stale data; Sàn-tier downgrade flag mandatory)\n83\t- Phase 1 thin-slice scope locks to HOSE only (VHM is HOSE; spec 000 § A.5 Out-of-Scope item 4).\n84\t- Charter \"First Sub-Scope\" mid-cap band (vốn hóa 2,000-50,000 tỷ VND) implicitly excludes most UPCoM stocks; this Rule codifies the data-quality reason.\n85\t\n86\t### The Enforcement\n87\t\n88\t`Bar.__post_init__` validates `sàn ∈ {HOSE, HNX, UPCoM}`. `ReconciliationService.tolerance_for(bar)` returns Sàn-tier tolerance. Backtest universe construction (per Rule 2) MUST tag `Sàn` per row; CI gate (Phase 2+) warns if backtest dataset mixes Sàn without explicit tier-aware logic.\n89\t\n90\t---\n91\t\n92\t## Rule 15 — FX VND-USD Point-in-Time Discipline\n93\t\n94\t### The Problem\n95\t\n96\tVN equities are priced VND. Some thesis comparisons reference USD-denominated peers (e.g., regional comparable PE). FX rates VND/USD drift 1-3% per quarter and 5-8% per year. A naive \"as_of FX rate\" lookup using today's rate to convert a 2024-Q1 metric distorts comparable analysis silently. Rule 5 already mandates explicit `Money.convert(target_currency, as_of_rate)`; Rule 15 codifies VN specifics and the FX rate source-attribution discipline.\n97\t\n98\t### The Rule\n99\t\n100\t- FX rates VND/USD (and any other pair) stored as `FxRate(currency_pair, as_of_date, rate, source_provider, ingested_at)` records per Rule 1 point-in-time integrity.\n101\t- `source_provider` for FX MUST be one of: `SBV` (Tỷ giá trung tâm State Bank of Vietnam — official reference rate) | `VCB` (Vietcombank cash quote) | `VNSTOCK` (vnstock historical FX endpoint, derived from interbank). NEVER LLM-extracted (I-S1).\n102\t- `Money.convert(target_currency, as_of_date)` resolves FX via `FxRateRepository.get_as_of(currency_pair, as_of_date)` — NOT current-day rate. If as_of_date pre-dates earliest stored FX rate, raise `FxRateNotAvailableError` (do NOT fallback to nearest); this preserves Rule 1 integrity at the FX layer.\n103\t- Backtest cross-currency: every conversion call records `(amount_native, amount_target, fx_rate_used, fx_as_of_date, fx_source)` for audit reproducibility per Rule 10.\n104\t- Phase 1 thin-slice: VND only (spec 000 § BR-3); FX subsystem stubbed but unused.\n105\t\n106\t### The Enforcement\n107\t\n108\t`Money.convert()` raises if FX rate unavailable for as_of_date. `FxRateRepository.get_as_of()` enforces point-in-time. CI test (Phase 2+): backtest with deliberate cross-currency comparison runs twice with same `(commit, snapshot, config, seed)` and produces identical converted values per Rule 10 reproducibility.\n109\t\n110\t---\n111\t\n112\t## Why Rules 12-15 Are Phase-1-Compatible Even Though Phase 1 Doesn't Enforce Them\n113\t\n114\tRules 12-15 are codified now to anchor S27-S28 entity design (Bar.sàn field, Position.opened_at semantics, FX placeholder structure) so Phase 2 enforcement layers slot into existing types without retrofitting. This matches Charter \"When in doubt, simplify\" + \"Ship thin slices\" — types are designed once, enforcement layers ship phase-by-phase.\n115\t\n116\t## End of amendment\n117\t"}]},"uuid":"24f1e787-82a8-49e2-b40a-29efebd0a78d","timestamp":"2026-04-30T14:42:17.346Z","toolUseResult":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge\\agent-workspace\\proposals\\financial-data-protocol-amendment-VN.md","content":"---\nstatus: PROPOSAL — AMENDMENT to existing agent-workspace/constitution/financial-data-protocol.md\nproposed_at: 2026-04-30\nproposed_by: Claude Opus 4.7 (S26 IMPL — Phase 1 Track B; master-plan 004 § S26 deliverable #1)\nsource_evidence:\n  - PROJECT_CHARTER.md § First Sub-Scope (HOSE/HNX/UPCoM, vốn hóa 2,000-50,000 tỷ VND, position sizing 5-15%, holding 1m-24m)\n  - agent-workspace/ubiquitous-language/glossary.md v1.0 (S25 deliverable; 42 VN terms incl. T+2.5, Room ngoại, Sàn HOSE/HNX/UPCoM, Trần, Sàn, Phiên ATO/ATC, Tỷ giá USD/VND)\n  - specs/tier2-feature/000-phase-1-thin-slice-VHM.md § A.3 BR-3 + BR-5 (T+2.5 informational; VND only Phase 1)\n  - agent-workspace/constitution/financial-data-protocol.md Rules 1-10 (existing baseline; this amendment APPENDS Rules 12-15 — Rule 11 reserved for S16 amendment Hook Portability)\n  - docs/DAY_1_CHECKLIST.md § A.4 + § B.1 (financial-data-protocol customization step)\ntarget_constitution_path: agent-workspace/constitution/financial-data-protocol.md\ntarget_section: NEW § \"Vietnam-Domain Rules 12-15\"\nmove_when: user explicit approve; insertion point = after \"## Rule 10: Backtest Reproducibility\" and before \"## Quick Reference Table\"\nrelates_to:\n  - financial-data-protocol-amendment.md (S16 — Rule 11 Hook Portability; ORTHOGONAL to this amendment, NOT a fold)\n  - invariants-amendment-VN.md (S26 sibling — I-S55-I-S65 invariants enforce these Rules)\n---\n\n# Financial Data Protocol Amendment — Vietnam-Domain Rules 12-15\n\n> **Status**: PROPOSAL pending user approve. Codifies VN-specific data integrity rules that emerged from glossary v1.0 (S25) and Phase 1 thin-slice spec (S25). Each Rule names existing glossary terms by exact spelling and references invariants-amendment-VN.md for enforcement.\n>\n> **Why these Rules and not others**: glossary v1.0 surfaced 8 critical VN-domain terms (T+2.5, Room ngoại, Đội lái, Mua chủ động, Bán chủ động, Sàn HOSE/HNX/UPCoM, Phiên ATO/ATC, Tỷ giá USD/VND). Rules 12-15 cover the 4 that are data-integrity-binding for Phase 1+ (settlement timing, foreign-cap detection, sàn-tier data quality, FX point-in-time). Đội lái + Mua/Bán chủ động + ATO/ATC are Phase 2+ (intraday + Tier 4 work) — deferred.\n\n## Append to `financial-data-protocol.md` (NEW section, after Rule 10)\n\n---\n\n## Rule 12 — T+2.5 Settlement Timing Awareness\n\n### The Problem\n\nVN equities settle T+2.5 (trade date + 2.5 trading days). A buy on Monday clears Wednesday afternoon; cash from a Monday sell is re-investable Wednesday afternoon. Backtests that ignore T+2.5 over-count compoundable cash by 2-3 trading days, producing false-positive performance especially for high-turnover strategies.\n\n### The Rule\n\n- Every `Position` entity tracks `opened_at` = trade-match date (NOT cleared-cash date).\n- Every cash-flow record carries `cleared_at = opened_at + T+2.5 trading days` (computed via VN trading calendar, not naive +3 calendar days).\n- Backtest re-investment available cash queries: `WHERE cleared_at <= action_date`.\n- Live cash queries may use `cleared_at <= today` for pre-trade checks; cash gating in `apps/cli/order_*.py` (Phase 2+) MUST consult cleared cash, not trade-match cash.\n- Phase 1 thin-slice exception: `Position.opened_at` is required, but T+2.5 cash gating is NOT enforced (deferred to Phase 2 when intraday/order-management lands per spec 000 § BR-5).\n\n### The Enforcement\n\n`PositionRepository.compute_cleared_cash(as_of_date)` is the only path for re-investable cash. No `available_cash()` method bypasses T+2.5. CI gate (Phase 2+) adds property test: random portfolio + random sell timing, assert `cleared_at - opened_at` always ≥2.5 trading days per VN calendar.\n\n---\n\n## Rule 13 — Room Ngoại (Foreign-Ownership Cap) Detection\n\n### The Problem\n\nForeign investors face a hard ceiling on per-stock ownership in VN equities. The cap is sector-dependent: banking ≤30%, real estate ≤49%, most industrial ≤49% with stock-specific overrides. When a stock saturates Room ngoại, foreign buy-pressure cannot accumulate further — the stock is effectively closed to foreign-flow signal until domestic holders sell to foreigners. Strategies that key on \"foreign accumulation\" silently fail on saturated stocks. Strategies that pump on \"Room ngoại near full\" (early signal of further foreign demand) miss the regime.\n\n### The Rule\n\n- Every `Bar` (BC-1) carries `foreign_buy_volume` + `foreign_sell_volume` (existing schema per architecture.md BC-1).\n- NEW per-Ticker daily snapshot record `ForeignOwnershipState`: `(ticker, date, foreign_owned_shares, foreign_cap_shares, saturation_pct, source_provider, ingested_at, as_of)`.\n- `saturation_pct = foreign_owned_shares / foreign_cap_shares`. When `saturation_pct >= 0.95`, the stock is in saturation regime — foreign-flow analysis must explicitly mark this.\n- Source provenance: HOSE listed-stocks portal + vnstock `room_ngoai()` endpoint + TCBS reconciliation per Rule 4. Rule 4 reconciliation tolerance = 1% of cap (NOT 1% of saturation_pct — different denominators).\n- Backtest queries on foreign accumulation MUST filter `WHERE saturation_pct < 0.95 OR explicit_saturation_strategy = TRUE`.\n\n### The Enforcement\n\n`ForeignOwnershipRepository` Protocol: `get_state_as_of(ticker, as_of_date)` + `get_saturated_universe(as_of_date, threshold=0.95)`. Bar+ForeignOwnership join in `MarketDataReadModel` denormalized view. Phase 1 thin-slice on VHM does NOT seed ForeignOwnership data (Phase 2 deliverable when full VN30 ingestion lands); Bar.foreign_buy / foreign_sell fields are seeded but Saturation analysis deferred.\n\n---\n\n## Rule 14 — Sàn HOSE / HNX / UPCoM Data-Quality Tiering\n\n### The Problem\n\nVN listed equities split across 3 exchanges (Sàn): HOSE (HCMC; tier-1 large caps; strictest disclosure), HNX (Hanoi; tier-2; mid-caps), UPCoM (over-the-counter board; tier-3; micro-caps + pre-listing transitional). Data quality, filing cadence, and cross-source reconciliation tolerance differ by Sàn. Treating UPCoM Bars with the same trust as HOSE Bars produces false-positive backtest signals on noisy UPCoM data.\n\n### The Rule\n\n- Every `Ticker` value object infers Sàn at construction (regex on listing-status feed: 3-letter alpha → HOSE; 3-letter alpha + HNX flag → HNX; UPCoM has explicit ticker namespace).\n- Every `Bar` carries `sàn` field (NEW; values: HOSE | HNX | UPCoM). Field is denormalized from Ticker for query performance (Rule 4 reconciliation runs per-Sàn).\n- Reconciliation tolerance per Rule 4 is Sàn-tiered:\n  - HOSE: ±1% (existing tolerance preserved)\n  - HNX: ±2% (mid-cap, slightly noisier filings)\n  - UPCoM: ±5% (micro-cap, frequent stale data; Sàn-tier downgrade flag mandatory)\n- Phase 1 thin-slice scope locks to HOSE only (VHM is HOSE; spec 000 § A.5 Out-of-Scope item 4).\n- Charter \"First Sub-Scope\" mid-cap band (vốn hóa 2,000-50,000 tỷ VND) implicitly excludes most UPCoM stocks; this Rule codifies the data-quality reason.\n\n### The Enforcement\n\n`Bar.__post_init__` validates `sàn ∈ {HOSE, HNX, UPCoM}`. `ReconciliationService.tolerance_for(bar)` returns Sàn-tier tolerance. Backtest universe construction (per Rule 2) MUST tag `Sàn` per row; CI gate (Phase 2+) warns if backtest dataset mixes Sàn without explicit tier-aware logic.\n\n---\n\n## Rule 15 — FX VND-USD Point-in-Time Discipline\n\n### The Problem\n\nVN equities are priced VND. Some thesis comparisons reference USD-denominated peers (e.g., regional comparable PE). FX rates VND/USD drift 1-3% per quarter and 5-8% per year. A naive \"as_of FX rate\" lookup using today's rate to convert a 2024-Q1 metric distorts comparable analysis silently. Rule 5 already mandates explicit `Money.convert(target_currency, as_of_rate)`; Rule 15 codifies VN specifics and the FX rate source-attribution discipline.\n\n### The Rule\n\n- FX rates VND/USD (and any other pair) stored as `FxRate(currency_pair, as_of_date, rate, source_provider, ingested_at)` records per Rule 1 point-in-time integrity.\n- `source_provider` for FX MUST be one of: `SBV` (Tỷ giá trung tâm State Bank of Vietnam — official reference rate) | `VCB` (Vietcombank cash quote) | `VNSTOCK` (vnstock historical FX endpoint, derived from interbank). NEVER LLM-extracted (I-S1).\n- `Money.convert(target_currency, as_of_date)` resolves FX via `FxRateRepository.get_as_of(currency_pair, as_of_date)` — NOT current-day rate. If as_of_date pre-dates earliest stored FX rate, raise `FxRateNotAvailableError` (do NOT fallback to nearest); this preserves Rule 1 integrity at the FX layer.\n- Backtest cross-currency: every conversion call records `(amount_native, amount_target, fx_rate_used, fx_as_of_date, fx_source)` for audit reproducibility per Rule 10.\n- Phase 1 thin-slice: VND only (spec 000 § BR-3); FX subsystem stubbed but unused.\n\n### The Enforcement\n\n`Money.convert()` raises if FX rate unavailable for as_of_date. `FxRateRepository.get_as_of()` enforces point-in-time. CI test (Phase 2+): backtest with deliberate cross-currency comparison runs twice with same `(commit, snapshot, config, seed)` and produces identical converted values per Rule 10 reproducibility.\n\n---\n\n## Why Rules 12-15 Are Phase-1-Compatible Even Though Phase 1 Doesn't Enforce Them\n\nRules 12-15 are codified now to anchor S27-S28 entity design (Bar.sàn field, Position.opened_at semantics, FX placeholder structure) so Phase 2 enforcement layers slot into existing types without retrofitting. No LLM, no network,\nno DB — pure deterministic comparison logic exercising financial-data-protocol\nRule 4 (\"Source Attribution & Reconciliation\").\n\nConfidence rules (matches Rule 4 verbatim):\n- Both sources present, divergence ≤ 1%: confidence = HIGH; reconciled close\n  = arithmetic mean of the two close values.\n- Both sources present, divergence > 1%: confidence = LOW; reconciled close\n  = primary (vnstock) close; both source values surfaced for audit.\n- Only one source has the day: confidence = SINGLE_SOURCE; reconciled close\n  = whatever was available; the missing source is recorded.\n\nManual override path (Rule 4 final clause: \"Manual override always wins, with\noverride_reason documented\") is deferred to Phase 2 — Phase 1 thin-slice has\nno human-in-the-loop reconciliation override per Q-S28-3.\n\nDivergence formula: `abs(close_a - close_b) / max(close_a, close_b)`. Currency\nmust match across the two close values; cross-currency comparison raises\n`CurrencyMismatchError` (re-raised from Money operators per Rule 5).\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom datetime import date\nfrom decimal import Decimal\nfrom enum import StrEnum\n\nfrom packages.contracts import CurrencyMismatchError, Money, SourceProvider, Ticker\nfrom packages.domain.market_data.models import Bar\n\n__all__ = [\n    \"ReconciledBar\",\n    \"ReconciliationConfidence\",\n    \"ReconciliationService\",\n]\n\n\n_DEFAULT_TOLERANCE = Decimal(\"0.01\")  # 1% per Rule 4\n\n\nclass ReconciliationConfidence(StrEnum):\n    \"\"\"Confidence taxonomy for a reconciled price point.\"\"\"\n\n    HIGH = \"high\"\n    LOW = \"low\"\n    SINGLE_SOURCE = \"single_source\"\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)\nclass ReconciledBar:\n    \"\"\"View row over two source Bars at the same (ticker, period_end) key.\"\"\"\n\n    ticker: Ticker\n    period_end: date\n    close_reconciled: Money\n    confidence: ReconciliationConfidence\n    divergence_pct: Decimal\n    sources_present: tuple[SourceProvider, ...]\n    close_by_source: dict[SourceProvider, Money]\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass ReconciliationService:\n    \"\"\"Stateless cross-source Bar reconciler. Construct once, call `reconcile`.\"\"\"\n\n    tolerance: Decimal = _DEFAULT_TOLERANCE\n\n    def reconcile(\n        self,\n        primary: list[Bar],\n        secondary: list[Bar],\n    ) -> list[ReconciledBar]:\n        \"\"\"Emit one ReconciledBar per unique (ticker, period_end) across inputs.\n\n        Inputs are not assumed sorted; the service builds (ticker, period_end)\n        index per source and walks the union of keys ascending by period_end\n        within each ticker. `primary` is treated as the leading provider\n        (vnstock in S28); `secondary` is the cross-check (TCBS in S28).\n        \"\"\"\n        primary_index = self._index(primary)\n        secondary_index = self._index(secondary)\n        all_keys = sorted(set(primary_index.keys()) | set(secondary_index.keys()))\n\n        out: list[ReconciledBar] = []\n        for key in all_keys:\n            ticker, period_end = key\n            p = primary_index.get(key)\n            s = secondary_index.get(key)\n            out.append(self._reconcile_single(ticker, period_end, p, s))\n        return out\n\n    def _reconcile_single(\n        self,\n        ticker: Ticker,\n        period_end: date,\n        primary_bar: Bar | None,\n        secondary_bar: Bar | None,\n    ) -> ReconciledBar:\n        if primary_bar is not None and secondary_bar is not None:\n            divergence = self._divergence_pct(primary_bar.close, secondary_bar.close)\n            if divergence <= self.tolerance:\n                close_reconciled = self._mean(primary_bar.close, secondary_bar.close)\n                confidence = ReconciliationConfidence.HIGH\n            else:\n                close_reconciled = primary_bar.close\n                confidence = ReconciliationConfidence.LOW\n            return ReconciledBar(\n                ticker=ticker,\n                period_end=period_end,\n                close_reconciled=close_reconciled,\n                confidence=confidence,\n                divergence_pct=divergence,\n                sources_present=(primary_bar.source_provider, secondary_bar.source_provider),\n                close_by_source={\n                    primary_bar.source_provider: primary_bar.close,\n                    secondary_bar.source_provider: secondary_bar.close,\n                },\n            )\n        present = primary_bar or secondary_bar\n        assert present is not None  # one must be set per all_keys construction\n        return ReconciledBar(\n            ticker=ticker,\n            period_end=period_end,\n            close_reconciled=present.close,\n            confidence=ReconciliationConfidence.SINGLE_SOURCE,\n            divergence_pct=Decimal(\"0\"),\n            sources_present=(present.source_provider,),\n            close_by_source={present.source_provider: present.close},\n        )\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def _divergence_pct(a: Money, b: Money) -> Decimal:\n        if a.currency != b.currency:\n            raise CurrencyMismatchError(a.currency, b.currency)\n        max_abs = max(a.amount, b.amount)\n        if max_abs == 0:\n            return Decimal(\"0\")\n        return abs(a.amount - b.amount) / max_abs\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def _mean(a: Money, b: Money) -> Money:\n        if a.currency != b.currency:\n            raise CurrencyMismatchError(a.currency, b.currency)\n        return Money((a.amount + b.amount) / Decimal(\"2\"), a.currency)\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def _index(bars: list[Bar]) -> dict[tuple[Ticker, date], Bar]:\n        return {(b.ticker, b.period_end): b for b in bars}\n","numLines":153,"startLine":1,"totalLines":153}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"736f97b3-68d4-4b56-8ccb-fc426ecd985c","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"26da415a-76e5-4042-8420-5582125d8a7d","version":"2.1.123","gitBranch":"main"}

default = end - 365 days\")\n@click.option(\"--end\", default=None, help=\"ISO date; default = today\")\n@click.option(\n    \"--output\",\n    default=\"./data/vhm.sqlite\",\n    show_default=True,\n    type=click.Path(dir_okay=False, path_type=Path),\n)\n@click.option(\"--report\", default=None, type=click.Path(dir_okay=False, path_type=Path))\ndef main(ticker: str, start: str | None, end: str | None, output: Path, report: Path | None) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Ingest a year of VHM (default) DAILY bars; reconcile vnstock vs TCBS.\"\"\"\n    _ensure_utf8_stdout()\n    end_date = date.fromisoformat(end) if end else date.today()\n    start_date = date.fromisoformat(start) if start else end_date - timedelta(days=365)\n    report_path = report if report is not None else output.with_name(output.stem + \"-reconciliation.md\")\n    t = Ticker(ticker)\n\n    click.echo(f\"[ingest_vhm] ticker={t.symbol} window={start_date}..{end_date}\")\n    click.echo(f\"[ingest_vhm] output={output} report={report_path}\")\n\n    vnstock_adapter = VnstockAdapter()\n    tcbs_adapter = TcbsAdapter()\n    reconciler = ReconciliationService()\n    repo = SqliteBarRepository(db_path=output)\n\n    try:\n        vnstock_bars = vnstock_adapter.fetch_daily(t, start_date, end_date)\n        click.echo(f\"[ingest_vhm] vnstock returned {len(vnstock_bars)} bars\")\n    except VnstockAdapterError as exc:\n        click.echo(f\"[ingest_vhm] vnstock FAILED: {exc}\", err=True)\n        return 2\n\n    try:\n        tcbs_bars = tcbs_adapter.fetch_daily(t, start_date, end_date)\n        click.echo(f\"[ingest_vhm] tcbs returned {len(tcbs_bars)} bars\")\n    except TcbsApiError as exc:\n        click.echo(f\"[ingest_vhm] tcbs unavailable, single-source mode: {exc}\", err=True)\n        tcbs_bars = []\n\n    written = repo.save_many(list(vnstock_bars) + list(tcbs_bars))\n    click.echo(f\"[ingest_vhm] wrote {written} rows; These tags are mandatory on every Bar\n5\trecord — mixing adjusted with unadjusted in same calculation = bug class.\n6\t\n7\t`str` mixin renders the lowercase token in JSON/TSV serialization, matching\n8\tthe pattern established by packages/observability/state_machine.HookEventState.\n9\t\"\"\"\n10\t\n11\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n12\t\n13\tfrom enum import StrEnum\n14\t\n15\t__all__ = [\"AdjustmentType\", \"SourceProvider\"]\n16\t\n17\t\n18\tclass AdjustmentType(StrEnum):\n19\t    \"\"\"Price-adjustment lineage for a Bar OHLCV record.\n20\t\n21\t    NONE     = raw historical (what was actually paid; pre-corporate-action)\n22\t    DIVIDEND = adjusted for dividends only\n23\t    SPLIT    = adjusted for stock splits only\n24\t    BOTH     = fully adjusted (typical for charts + return calculations)\n25\t\n26\t    Per Rule 3: mixing AdjustmentType in same calculation raises\n27\t    MixedAdjustmentError (enforced at the service / repository layer; Phase 2).\n28\t    \"\"\"\n29\t\n30\t    NONE = \"none\"\n31\t    DIVIDEND = \"dividend\"\n32\t    SPLIT = \"split\"\n33\t    BOTH = \"both\"\n34\t\n35\t\n36\tclass SourceProvider(StrEnum):\n37\t    \"\"\"Data provider lineage for a Bar record. Drives reconciliation per Rule 4.\n38\t\n39\t    Phase 1 thin-slice uses VNSTOCK + TCBS (S28 ingestion adapter); FIINPRO +\n40\t    SSI + WICHART deferred to Phase 2-3 per Charter § Data Sources budget tier.\n41\t    MANUAL is reserved for hand-corrected entries with override_reason.\n42\t    SCRAPED_OTHER catches any new source pre-formal-add (audit-flagged).\n43\t    \"\"\"\n44\t\n45\t    VNSTOCK = \"vnstock\"\n46\t    TCBS = \"tcbs\"\n47\t    FIINPRO = \"fiinpro\"\n48\t    SSI = \"ssi\"\n49\t    WICHART = \"wichart\"\n50\t    MANUAL = \"manual\"\n51\t    SCRAPED_OTHER = \"scraped_other\"\n52\t"}]},"uuid":"8860c2a0-619e-435f-8d39-6d77616b7552","timestamp":"2026-04-30T14:43:19.526Z","toolUseResult":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge\\packages\\contracts\\types\\adjustment_type.py","content":"\"\"\"AdjustmentType + SourceProvider — Bar tagging Enums.\n\nPer financial-data-protocol Rule 3 (Adjustment Type Tagging) + Rule 4 (Source\nAttribution) + invariants I-S4 + I-S5. These tags are mandatory on every Bar\nrecord — mixing adjusted with unadjusted in same calculation = bug class.\n\n`str` mixin renders the lowercase token in JSON/TSV serialization, matching\nthe pattern established by packages/observability/state_machine.HookEventState.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom enum import StrEnum\n\n__all__ = [\"AdjustmentType\", \"SourceProvider\"]\n\n\nclass AdjustmentType(StrEnum):\n    \"\"\"Price-adjustment lineage for a Bar OHLCV record.\n\n    NONE     = raw historical (what was actually paid; pre-corporate-action)\n    DIVIDEND = adjusted for dividends only\n    SPLIT    = adjusted for stock splits only\n    BOTH     = fully adjusted (typical for charts + return calculations)\n\n    Per Rule 3: mixing AdjustmentType in same calculation raises\n    MixedAdjustmentError (enforced at the service / repository layer; Phase 2).\n    \"\"\"\n\n    NONE = \"none\"\n    DIVIDEND = \"dividend\"\n    SPLIT = \"split\"\n    BOTH = \"both\"\n\n\nclass SourceProvider(StrEnum):\n    \"\"\"Data provider lineage for a Bar record. Drives reconciliation per Rule 4.\n\n    Phase 1 thin-slice uses VNSTOCK + TCBS (S28 ingestion adapter); FIINPRO +\n    SSI + WICHART deferred to Phase 2-3 per Charter § Data Sources budget tier.\n    MANUAL is reserved for hand-corrected entries with override_reason.\n    SCRAPED_OTHER catches any new source pre-formal-add (audit-flagged).\n    \"\"\"\n\n    VNSTOCK = \"vnstock\"\n    TCBS = \"tcbs\"\n    FIINPRO = \"fiinpro\"\n    SSI = \"ssi\"\n    WICHART = \"wichart\"\n    MANUAL = \"manual\"\n    SCRAPED_OTHER = \"scraped_other\"\n","numLines":52,"startLine":1,"totalLines":52}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"e00c250f-1af8-4db8-87c2-3209e23f84da","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"26da415a-76e5-4042-8420-5582125d8a7d","version":"2.1.123","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"7590cf09-ce8f-43b8-8a06-740c1882fa4c","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-7","id":"msg_01NKxcNydQH32ZjH4Fqmqt4v","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01AbAqcBgTjpVH35Xj325tDn","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge\\packages\\infrastructure\\market_data\\ssi_adapter.py","content":"\"\"\"SsiAdapter — fetch DAILY Bars via SSI iBoard public chart API (httpx direct).\n\nImplements `BarProviderPort` (S32 Track A R2 closure). Per D-012 (S32):\nTCBS public `stock-insight` endpoint family returned 404 across all probed\nURL variants throughout S32; vnstock 4.0.2 `Quote` source backends are\neffectively VCI-only in practice (TCBS/SSI/DNSE/FMARKET fail on\nconstruction; MSN unreachable). SSI's iBoard chart-history endpoint at\n`https://iboard-api.ssi.com.vn/statistics/charts/history` is publicly\nreachable and returned full 1-year OHLCV for 30/30 VN30 tickers (248 bars\neach) during S32 coverage probe — restoring Rule 4 multi-source\nreconciliation discipline previously broken by R2.\n\nEndpoint shape (TradingView-style; `from`/`to` are unix epoch seconds):\n\n    GET https://iboard-api.ssi.com.vn/statistics/charts/history\n        ?symbol=VHM&resolution=D&from=1714435200&to=1745971200\n\n    {\n      \"code\": \"SUCCESS\",\n      \"message\": \"...\",\n      \"data\": {\n        \"t\": [1714608000, 1714694400, ...],       # epoch seconds (UTC midnight)\n        \"o\": [40.8, 40.5, ...],                    # open  (THOUSAND VND)\n        \"h\": [41.25, 40.7, ...],                   # high  (THOUSAND VND)\n        \"l\": [40.35, 40.1, ...],                   # low   (THOUSAND VND)\n        \"c\": [41.15, 40.4, ...],                   # close (THOUSAND VND)\n        \"v\": [4570000, 5102100, ...],              # volume (shares)\n        \"s\": \"ok\",\n        \"nextTime\": null\n      }\n    }\n\nPrices are in **thousand VND** (close=41.15 means 41,150 VND/share),\nmatching the convention shared by VnstockAdapter so reconciliation does\nnot need a unit-conversion step.\n\nPer Q-S28-3 + agent-notes \"stale data must propagate\": non-200 OR\nunexpected payload → `SsiApiError`. The CLI orchestrator catches it and\nlogs single-source mode; never falls back silently. `http_get_fn` is\ninjected for test isolation per the same pattern as TcbsAdapter.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport time\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom datetime import UTC, date, datetime\nfrom decimal import Decimal\nfrom typing import Protocol, cast\n\nfrom packages.contracts import (\n    AdjustmentType,\n    Currency,\n    Money,\n    SourceProvider,\n    Ticker,\n)\nfrom packages.domain.market_data.models import Bar\n\n__all__ = [\"SsiAdapter\", \"SsiApiError\"]\n\n\n_SSI_BASE_URL = \"https://iboard-api.ssi.com.vn/statistics/charts/history\"\n_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 10.0\n_VND_THOUSANDS_MULTIPLIER = Decimal(\"1000\")\n\nParamValue = str | int\n\n\nclass HttpResponse(Protocol):\n    \"\"\"Minimal httpx.Response surface the adapter consumes.\"\"\"\n\n    status_code: int\n\n    def json(self) -> object: ...\n\n\nclass HttpGetFn(Protocol):\n    \"\"\"Injectable HTTP GET. Production wraps httpx.get; tests pass fake.\"\"\"\n\n    def __call__(self, url: str, params: dict[str, ParamValue]) -> HttpResponse: ...\n\n\nclass SsiApiError(RuntimeError):\n    \"\"\"Raised when SSI iBoard API returns non-200 or unexpected payload shape.\"\"\"\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass SsiAdapter:\n    \"\"\"Fetch DAILY OHLCV via SSI iBoard public chart API.\n\n    `http_get_fn` is an injectable hook returning an object with `.status_code`\n    and `.json()` (httpx.Response shape). Production wiring constructs it from\n    httpx; tests pass a lambda returning a fake response so no network is\n    required per architecture.md § Testing fixture discipline.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    http_get_fn: HttpGetFn | None = None\n    timeout_seconds: float = _DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS\n    rate_limit_seconds: float = 1.0\n    _last_call_at: float = 0.0\n\n    def __post_init__(self) -> None:\n        if self.http_get_fn is None:\n            try:\n                import httpx\n            except ImportError as exc:\n                raise SsiApiError(\n                    \"httpx not installed; pip install httpx\"\n                ) from exc\n\n            def _http_get(url: str, params: dict[str, ParamValue]) -> HttpResponse:\n                return cast(\n                    HttpResponse,\n                    httpx.get(\n                        url,\n                        params=params,\n                        timeout=self.timeout_seconds,\n                        headers={\"User-Agent\": \"Mozilla/5.0 stockforge\"},\n                    ),\n                )\n\n            object.__setattr__(self, \"http_get_fn\", _http_get)\n\n    def fetch_daily(self, ticker: Ticker, start: date, end: date) -> list[Bar]:\n        if start > end:\n            raise ValueError(f\"start {start} > end {end}\")\n        self._respect_rate_limit()\n        assert self.http_get_fn is not None  # __post_init__ wires default\n\n        from_epoch = int(datetime.combine(start, datetime.min.time()).timestamp())\n        to_epoch = int(datetime.combine(end, datetime.min.time()).timestamp())\n        params: dict[str, ParamValue] = {\n            \"symbol\": ticker.symbol,\n            \"resolution\": \"D\",\n            \"from\": from_epoch,\n            \"to\": to_epoch,\n        }\n\n        response = self.http_get_fn(_SSI_BASE_URL, params)\n        status = getattr(response, \"status_code\", None)\n        if status != 200:\n            raise SsiApiError(\n                f\"SSI iBoard API returned status {status} for symbol={ticker.symbol}\"\n            )\n        payload = response.json()\n        if not isinstance(payload, dict) or \"data\" not in payload:\n            raise SsiApiError(f\"unexpected payload shape: {type(payload).__name__}\")\n        data = payload[\"data\"]\n        if not isinstance(data, dict):\n            raise SsiApiError(f\"unexpected data shape: {type(data).__name__}\")\n\n        times = data.get(\"t\") or []\n        opens = data.get(\"o\") or []\n        highs = data.get(\"h\") or []\n        lows = data.get(\"l\") or []\n        closes = data.get(\"c\") or []\n        volumes = data.get(\"v\") or []\n        if not isinstance(times, list):\n            raise SsiApiError(\"data.t is not a list\")\n        n = len(times)\n        if not all(isinstance(arr, list) and len(arr) == n for arr in (opens, highs, lows, closes, volumes)):\n            raise SsiApiError(\"OHLCV arrays length mismatch\")\n\n        ingested_at = datetime.now(UTC)\n        bars: list[Bar] = []\n        for i in range(n):\n            period_end = self._epoch_to_date(times[i])\n            if period_end is None or period_end < start or period_end > end:\n                continue\n            try:\n                bars.append(\n                    Bar(\n                        ticker=ticker,\n                        period_end=period_end,\n                        filing_date=period_end,\n                        ingested_at=ingested_at,\n                        open=self._money_thousand(opens[i]),\n                        high=self._money_thousand(highs[i]),\n                        low=self._money_thousand(lows[i]),\n                        close=self._money_thousand(closes[i]),\n                        volume=int(volumes[i]),\n                        foreign_buy=0,\n                        foreign_sell=0,\n                        adjustment_type=AdjustmentType.BOTH,\n                        source_provider=SourceProvider.SSI,\n                    )\n                )\n            except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:\n                raise SsiApiError(f\"row {i} malformed: {exc}\") from Per D-012 (S32):\nTCBS public `stock-insight` endpoint family returned 404 across all probed\nURL variants throughout S32; vnstock 4.0.2 `Quote` source backends are\neffectively VCI-only in practice (TCBS/SSI/DNSE/FMARKET fail on\nconstruction; MSN unreachable). SSI's iBoard chart-history endpoint at\n`https://iboard-api.ssi.com.vn/statistics/charts/history` is publicly\nreachable and returned full 1-year OHLCV for 30/30 VN30 tickers (248 bars\neach) during S32 coverage probe — restoring Rule 4 multi-source\nreconciliation discipline previously broken by R2.\n\nEndpoint shape (TradingView-style; `from`/`to` are unix epoch seconds):\n\n    GET https://iboard-api.ssi.com.vn/statistics/charts/history\n        ?symbol=VHM&resolution=D&from=1714435200&to=1745971200\n\n    {\n      \"code\": \"SUCCESS\",\n      \"message\": \"...\",\n      \"data\": {\n        \"t\": [1714608000, 1714694400, ...],       # epoch seconds (UTC midnight)\n        \"o\": [40.8, 40.5, ...],                    # open  (THOUSAND VND)\n        \"h\": [41.25, 40.7, ...],                   # high  (THOUSAND VND)\n        \"l\": [40.35, 40.1, ...],                   # low   (THOUSAND VND)\n        \"c\": [41.15, 40.4, ...],                   # close (THOUSAND VND)\n        \"v\": [4570000, 5102100, ...],              # volume (shares)\n        \"s\": \"ok\",\n        \"nextTime\": null\n      }\n    }\n\nPrices are in **thousand VND** (close=41.15 means 41,150 VND/share),\nmatching the convention shared by VnstockAdapter so reconciliation does\nnot need a unit-conversion step.\n\nPer Q-S28-3 + agent-notes \"stale data must propagate\": non-200 OR\nunexpected payload → `SsiApiError`. The CLI orchestrator catches it and\nlogs single-source mode; never falls back silently. `http_get_fn` is\ninjected for test isolation per the same pattern as TcbsAdapter.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport time\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom datetime import UTC, date, datetime\nfrom decimal import Decimal\nfrom typing import Protocol, cast\n\nfrom packages.contracts import (\n    AdjustmentType,\n    Currency,\n    Money,\n    SourceProvider,\n    Ticker,\n)\nfrom packages.domain.market_data.models import Bar\n\n__all__ = [\"SsiAdapter\", \"SsiApiError\"]\n\n\n_SSI_BASE_URL = \"https://iboard-api.ssi.com.vn/statistics/charts/history\"\n_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 10.0\n_VND_THOUSANDS_MULTIPLIER = Decimal(\"1000\")\n\nParamValue = str | int\n\n\nclass HttpResponse(Protocol):\n    \"\"\"Minimal httpx.Response surface the adapter consumes.\"\"\"\n\n    status_code: int\n\n    def json(self) -> object: ...\n\n\nclass HttpGetFn(Protocol):\n    \"\"\"Injectable HTTP GET. Production wraps httpx.get; tests pass fake.\"\"\"\n\n    def __call__(self, url: str, params: dict[str, ParamValue]) -> HttpResponse: ...\n\n\nclass SsiApiError(RuntimeError):\n    \"\"\"Raised when SSI iBoard API returns non-200 or unexpected payload shape.\"\"\"\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass SsiAdapter:\n    \"\"\"Fetch DAILY OHLCV via SSI iBoard public chart API.\n\n    `http_get_fn` is an injectable hook returning an object with `.status_code`\n    and `.json()` (httpx.Response shape). Production wiring constructs it from\n    httpx; tests pass a lambda returning a fake response so no network is\n    required per architecture.md § Testing fixture discipline.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    http_get_fn: HttpGetFn | None = None\n    timeout_seconds: float = _DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS\n    rate_limit_seconds: float = 1.0\n    _last_call_at: float = 0.0\n\n    def __post_init__(self) -> None:\n        if self.http_get_fn is None:\n            try:\n                import httpx\n            except ImportError as exc:\n                raise SsiApiError(\n                    \"httpx not installed; pip install httpx\"\n                ) from exc\n\n            def _http_get(url: str, params: dict[str, ParamValue]) -> HttpResponse:\n                return cast(\n                    HttpResponse,\n                    httpx.get(\n                        url,\n                        params=params,\n                        timeout=self.timeout_seconds,\n                        headers={\"User-Agent\": \"Mozilla/5.0 stockforge\"},\n                    ),\n                )\n\n            object.__setattr__(self, \"http_get_fn\", _http_get)\n\n    def fetch_daily(self, ticker: Ticker, start: date, end: date) -> list[Bar]:\n        if start > end:\n            raise ValueError(f\"start {start} > end {end}\")\n        self._respect_rate_limit()\n        assert self.http_get_fn is not None  # __post_init__ wires default\n\n        from_epoch = int(datetime.combine(start, datetime.min.time()).timestamp())\n        to_epoch = int(datetime.combine(end, datetime.min.time()).timestamp())\n        params: dict[str, ParamValue] = {\n            \"symbol\": ticker.symbol,\n            \"resolution\": \"D\",\n            \"from\": from_epoch,\n            \"to\": to_epoch,\n        }\n\n        response = self.http_get_fn(_SSI_BASE_URL, params)\n        status = getattr(response, \"status_code\", None)\n        if status != 200:\n            raise SsiApiError(\n                f\"SSI iBoard API returned status {status} for symbol={ticker.symbol}\"\n            )\n        payload = response.json()\n        if not isinstance(payload, dict) or \"data\" not in payload:\n            raise SsiApiError(f\"unexpected payload shape: {type(payload).__name__}\")\n        data = payload[\"data\"]\n        if not isinstance(data, dict):\n            raise SsiApiError(f\"unexpected data shape: {type(data).__name__}\")\n\n        times = data.get(\"t\") or []\n        opens = data.get(\"o\") or []\n        highs = data.get(\"h\") or []\n        lows = data.get(\"l\") or []\n        closes = data.get(\"c\") or []\n        volumes = data.get(\"v\") or []\n        if not isinstance(times, list):\n            raise SsiApiError(\"data.t is not a list\")\n        n = len(times)\n        if not all(isinstance(arr, list) and len(arr) == n for arr in (opens, highs, lows, closes, volumes)):\n            raise SsiApiError(\"OHLCV arrays length mismatch\")\n\n        ingested_at = datetime.now(UTC)\n        bars: list[Bar] = []\n        for i in range(n):\n            period_end = self._epoch_to_date(times[i])\n            if period_end is None or period_end < start or period_end > end:\n                continue\n            try:\n                bars.append(\n                    Bar(\n                        ticker=ticker,\n                        period_end=period_end,\n                        filing_date=period_end,\n                        ingested_at=ingested_at,\n                        open=self._money_thousand(opens[i]),\n                        high=self._money_thousand(highs[i]),\n                        low=self._money_thousand(lows[i]),\n                        close=self._money_thousand(closes[i]),\n                        volume=int(volumes[i]),\n                        foreign_buy=0,\n                        foreign_sell=0,\n                        adjustment_type=AdjustmentType.BOTH,\n                        source_provider=SourceProvider.SSI,\n                    )\n                )\n            except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:\n                raise SsiApiError(f\"row {i} malformed: {exc}\") from exc\n        bars.sort(key=lambda b: b.period_end)\n        return bars\n\n    def _respect_rate_limit(self) -> None:\n        elapsed = time.monotonic() - self._last_call_at\n        if 0 < elapsed < self.rate_limit_seconds:\n            time.sleep(self.rate_limit_seconds - elapsed)\n        object.__setattr__(self, \"_last_call_at\", time.monotonic())\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def _epoch_to_date(value: object) -> date | None:\n        if value is None:\n            return None\n        if isinstance(value, int | float):\n            return datetime.fromtimestamp(float(value), tz=UTC).date()\n        return None\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def _money_thousand(thousand_vnd: object) -> Money:\n        amount = Decimal(str(thousand_vnd)) * _VND_THOUSANDS_MULTIPLIER\n        return Money(amount, Currency.VND)\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"b7940950-556c-4bf7-9466-ae4ec6ff3dcc","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"26da415a-76e5-4042-8420-5582125d8a7d","version":"2.1.123","gitBranch":"main"}

Pairs with VnstockAdapter as the second\nprovider per Rule 4 (source attribution + reconciliation). Sets\n`source_provider=SourceProvider.TCBS` on every emitted Bar.\n\nEndpoint pattern: `https://apipubaws.tcbs.com.vn/stock-insight/v2/stock/\nbars-long-term` with query params `(ticker, type=stock, resolution=D, to=<epoch>,\ncountBack=<n>)`. Response shape (when reachable):\n\n    {\n      \"data\": [\n        {\"open\": 124000, \"high\": 124200, \"low\": 122500, \"close\": 123100,\n         \"volume\": 2500900, \"tradingDate\": \"2026-04-29T00:00:00.000Z\"},\n        ...\n      ],\n      \"ticker\": \"VHM\",\n      \"page\": 0\n    }\n\nPer Q-S28-3 + agent-notes \"stale data must propagate\": if the endpoint returns\nnon-200 OR an unexpected payload shape, this adapter raises `TcbsApiError`.\nThe CLI orchestrator (apps/cli/ingest_vhm.py) catches it, logs the cause,\nand continues in single-source (vnstock-only) mode — surfacing the gap on the\nreconciliation report rather than silently falling back to a fake source.\n\nhttpx is used directly (not requests) because it shares pyproject deps with\nthe wider stockforge LLM transport stack and has cleaner timeout + retry\nsemantics. `http_client_fn` is injected for test isolation per the same\npattern as VnstockAdapter.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport time\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom datetime import UTC, date, datetime\nfrom decimal import Decimal\nfrom typing import Protocol, cast\n\nfrom packages.contracts import (\n    AdjustmentType,\n    Currency,\n    Money,\n    SourceProvider,\n    Ticker,\n)\nfrom packages.domain.market_data.models import Bar\n\n__all__ = [\"TcbsAdapter\", \"TcbsApiError\"]\n\n\n_TCBS_BASE_URL = \"https://apipubaws.tcbs.com.vn/stock-insight/v2/stock/bars-long-term\"\n_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 10.0\n\nParamValue = str | int\n\n\nclass HttpResponse(Protocol):\n    \"\"\"Minimal httpx.Response surface the adapter consumes.\"\"\"\n\n    status_code: int\n\n    def json(self) -> object: ...\n\n\nclass HttpGetFn(Protocol):\n    \"\"\"Injectable HTTP GET. Production wraps httpx.get; tests pass fake.\"\"\"\n\n    def __call__(self, url: str, params: dict[str, ParamValue]) -> HttpResponse: ...\n\n\nclass TcbsApiError(RuntimeError):\n    \"\"\"Raised when TCBS public API returns non-200 or unexpected payload.\"\"\"\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass TcbsAdapter:\n    \"\"\"Fetch DAILY OHLCV via TCBS public REST API. Implements BarProviderPort.\n\n    `http_get_fn` is an injectable hook returning an object with `.status_code`\n    and `.json()` (httpx.Response shape). Production wiring constructs it from\n    httpx; tests pass a lambda returning a fake response so no network is\n    required per architecture.md § Testing fixture discipline.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    http_get_fn: HttpGetFn | None = None\n    timeout_seconds: float = _DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS\n    rate_limit_seconds: float = 1.0\n    _last_call_at: float = 0.0\n\n    def __post_init__(self) -> None:\n        if self.http_get_fn is None:\n            try:\n                import httpx\n            except ImportError as exc:\n                raise TcbsApiError(\n                    \"httpx not installed; pip install httpx\"\n                ) from exc\n\n            def _http_get(url: str, params: dict[str, ParamValue]) -> HttpResponse:\n                return cast(\n                    HttpResponse,\n                    httpx.get(\n                        url,\n                        params=params,\n                        timeout=self.timeout_seconds,\n                        headers={\"User-Agent\": \"Mozilla/5.0 stockforge\"},\n                    ),\n                )\n\n            object.__setattr__(self, \"http_get_fn\", _http_get)\n\n    def fetch_daily(self, ticker: Ticker, start: date, end: date) -> list[Bar]:\n        if start > end:\n            raise ValueError(f\"start {start} > end {end}\")\n        self._respect_rate_limit()\n        assert self.http_get_fn is not None  # __post_init__ wires default\n\n        end_epoch = int(datetime.combine(end, datetime.min.time()).timestamp())\n        # countBack with margin so we cover trading days plus weekends in range\n        count_back = (end - start).days + 5\n        params: dict[str, ParamValue] = {\n            \"ticker\": ticker.symbol,\n            \"type\": \"stock\",\n            \"resolution\": \"D\",\n            \"to\": end_epoch,\n            \"countBack\": count_back,\n        }\n\n        response = self.http_get_fn(_TCBS_BASE_URL, params)\n        status = getattr(response, \"status_code\", None)\n        if status != 200:\n            raise TcbsApiError(\n                f\"TCBS API returned status {status} for ticker={ticker.symbol}\"\n            )\n        payload = response.json()\n        if not isinstance(payload, dict) or \"data\" not in payload:\n            raise TcbsApiError(f\"unexpected payload shape: {type(payload).__name__}\")\n\n        ingested_at = datetime.now(UTC)\n        bars: list[Bar] = []\n        for row in payload[\"data\"]:\n            period_end = self._parse_trading_date(row.get(\"tradingDate\"))\n            if period_end is None or period_end < start or period_end > end:\n                continue\n            try:\n                bars.append(\n                    Bar(\n                        ticker=ticker,\n                        period_end=period_end,\n                        filing_date=period_end,\n                        ingested_at=ingested_at,\n                        open=self._money(row[\"open\"]),\n                        high=self._money(row[\"high\"]),\n                        low=self._money(row[\"low\"]),\n                        close=self._money(row[\"close\"]),\n                        volume=int(row.get(\"volume\", 0)),\n                        foreign_buy=0,\n                        foreign_sell=0,\n                        adjustment_type=AdjustmentType.BOTH,\n                        source_provider=SourceProvider.TCBS,\n                    )\n                )\n            except (KeyError, TypeError) as exc:\n                raise TcbsApiError(f\"row missing required field: {exc}\") from exc\n        bars.sort(key=lambda b: b.period_end)\n        return bars\n\n    def _respect_rate_limit(self) -> None:\n        elapsed = time.monotonic() - self._last_call_at\n        if 0 < elapsed < self.rate_limit_seconds:\n            time.sleep(self.rate_limit_seconds - elapsed)\n        object.__setattr__(self, \"_last_call_at\", time.monotonic())\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def _parse_trading_date(value: object) -> date | None:\n        if value is None:\n            return None\n        if isinstance(value, date) and not isinstance(value, datetime):\n            return value\n        if isinstance(value, datetime):\n            return value.date()\n        if isinstance(value, str):\n            return datetime.strptime(value[:10], \"%Y-%m-%d\").date()\n        return None\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def _money(raw_vnd: object) -> Money:\n        return Money(Decimal(str(raw_vnd)), Currency.VND)\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":1,"oldLines":5,"newStart":1,"newLines":12,"lines":[" \"\"\"TcbsAdapter — fetch DAILY Bars via TCBS public REST API (httpx direct)."," ","+> **DEPRECATED TcbsAdapter\nremains wired in graceful-fail mode for archive symmetry — invoked but\nexpected to raise; reconciliation simply ignores its empty output.\n\nRun: `python apps/cli/ingest_vhm.py --start 2025-04-30 --end 2026-04-29`.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sys\nfrom datetime import date, timedelta\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport click\n\nfrom packages.contracts import Ticker\nfrom packages.infrastructure.market_data import (\n    ReconciledBar,\n    ReconciliationConfidence,\n    ReconciliationService,\n    SqliteBarRepository,\n    SsiAdapter,\n    SsiApiError,\n    TcbsAdapter,\n    TcbsApiError,\n    VnstockAdapter,\n    VnstockAdapterError,\n)","originalFile":"\"\"\"ingest_vhm — Tier 1 thin-slice ingestion driver for VHM (Phase 1 exemplar).\n\nOrchestrates VnstockAdapter + TcbsAdapter via ReconciliationService, persists\nthe union of source Bars via SqliteBarRepository, and emits a reconciliation\nreport markdown. Per master-plan 004 § S28 + Q-S28-3 (TCBS unreachable = log\n+ continue, not block).\n\nRun: `python apps/cli/ingest_vhm.py --start 2025-04-30 --end 2026-04-29`.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sys\nfrom datetime import date, timedelta\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport click\n\nfrom packages.contracts import Ticker\nfrom packages.infrastructure.market_data import (\n    ReconciledBar,\n    ReconciliationConfidence,\n    ReconciliationService,\n    SqliteBarRepository,\n    TcbsAdapter,\n    TcbsApiError,\n    VnstockAdapter,\n    VnstockAdapterError,\n)\n\n\ndef _ensure_utf8_stdout() -> None:\n    \"\"\"Reconfigure stdout to UTF-8 so vnstock's Vietnamese banner does not\n    UnicodeEncodeError under Windows cp1252. Called from `main` before the\n    first VnstockAdapter construction (which lazily imports vnstock).\n    \"\"\"\n    _reconfigure = getattr(sys.stdout, \"reconfigure\", None)\n    if callable(_reconfigure):\n        _reconfigure(encoding=\"utf-8\")\n\n\n@click.command()\n@click.option(\"--ticker\", default=\"VHM\", show_default=True)\n@click.option(\"--start\", default=None, help=\"ISO date; default = end - 365 days\")\n@click.option(\"--end\", default=None, help=\"ISO date; default = today\")\n@click.option(\n    \"--output\",\n    default=\"./data/vhm.sqlite\",\n    show_default=True,\n    type=click.Path(dir_okay=False, path_type=Path),\n)\n@click.option(\"--report\", default=None, type=click.Path(dir_okay=False, path_type=Path))\ndef main(ticker: str, start: str | None, end: str | None, output: Path, report: Path | None) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Ingest a year of VHM (default) DAILY bars; reconcile vnstock vs TCBS.\"\"\"\n    _ensure_utf8_stdout()\n    end_date = date.fromisoformat(end) if end else date.today()\n    start_date = date.fromisoformat(start) if start else end_date - timedelta(days=365)\n    report_path = report if report is not None else output.with_name(output.stem + \"-reconciliation.md\")\n    t = Ticker(ticker)\n\n    click.echo(f\"[ingest_vhm] ticker={t.symbol} window={start_date}..{end_date}\")\n    click.echo(f\"[ingest_vhm] output={output} report={report_path}\")\n\n    vnstock_adapter = VnstockAdapter()\n    tcbs_adapter = TcbsAdapter()\n    reconciler = ReconciliationService()\n    repo = SqliteBarRepository(db_path=output)\n\n    try:\n        vnstock_bars = vnstock_adapter.fetch_daily(t, start_date, end_date)\n        click.echo(f\"[ingest_vhm] vnstock returned {len(vnstock_bars)} bars\")\n    except VnstockAdapterError as exc:\n        click.echo(f\"[ingest_vhm] vnstock FAILED: {exc}\", err=True)\n        return 2\n\n    try:\n        tcbs_bars = tcbs_adapter.fetch_daily(t, start_date, end_date)\n        click.echo(f\"[ingest_vhm] tcbs returned {len(tcbs_bars)} bars\")\n    except TcbsApiError as exc:\n        click.echo(f\"[ingest_vhm] tcbs unavailable, single-source mode: {exc}\", err=True)\n        tcbs_bars = []\n\n    written = repo.save_many(list(vnstock_bars) + list(tcbs_bars))\n    click.echo(f\"[ingest_vhm] wrote {written} rows; total in db = {repo.count()}\")\n\n    reconciled = reconciler.reconcile(vnstock_bars, tcbs_bars)\n    _write_report(report_path, t, start_date, end_date, reconciled)\n    click.echo(f\"[ingest_vhm] reconciliation report written: {report_path}\")\n    click.echo(\"[ingest_vhm] OK\")\n    return 0\n\n\ndef _write_report(\n    path: Path,\n    ticker: Ticker,\n    start: date,\n    end: date,\n    rows: list[ReconciledBar],\n) -> None:\n    high = sum(1 for r in rows if r.confidence == ReconciliationConfidence.HIGH)\n    low = sum(1 for r in rows if r.confidence == ReconciliationConfidence.LOW)\n    single = sum(1 for r in rows if r.confidence == ReconciliationConfidence.SINGLE_SOURCE)\n    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    lines: list[str] = [\n        f\"# Reconciliation Report — {ticker.symbol}\",\n        \"\",\n        f\"**Window**: {start} → {end}\",\n        f\"**Total rows**: {len(rows)}\",\n        f\"- HIGH (within 1%): {high}\",\n        f\"- LOW (>1% divergence): {low}\",\n        f\"- SINGLE_SOURCE: {single}\",\n        \"\",\n        \"## Sample divergences (LOW)\",\n        \"\",\n    ]\n    samples = [r for r in rows if r.confidence == ReconciliationConfidence.LOW][:5]\n    if not samples:\n        lines.append(\"(none)\")\n    else:\n        for r in samples:\n            closes = {k.value: str(v.amount) for k, v in r.close_by_source.items()}\n            lines.append(f\"- {r.period_end}: divergence={r.divergence_pct} closes={closes}\")\n    path.write_text(\"\\n\".join(lines) + \"\\n\", encoding=\"utf-8\")\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    sys.exit(main(standalone_mode=False) or 0)\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":1,"oldLines":10,"newStart":1,"newLines":15,"lines":[" total in db = {repo.count()}\")\n\n    reconciled = reconciler.reconcile(vnstock_bars, ssi_bars)\n    _write_report(report_path, t, start_date, end_date, reconciled)\n    click.echo(f\"[ingest_vhm] reconciliation report written: {report_path}\")\n    click.echo(\"[ingest_vhm] OK\")\n    return 0","originalFile":"\"\"\"ingest_vhm — Tier 1 thin-slice ingestion driver for VHM (Phase 1 exemplar).\n\nOrchestrates VnstockAdapter (VCI) + SsiAdapter (iBoard) via\nReconciliationService, persists the union of source Bars via\nSqliteBarRepository, and emits a reconciliation report markdown.\n\nPer S32 Track A R2 closure (D-012): TCBS public REST endpoints returned 404\nacross all probed variants; SSI iBoard chart-history is the primary alternate\nsource paired with VCI for Rule 4 multi-source reconciliation. TcbsAdapter\nremains wired in graceful-fail mode for archive symmetry — invoked but\nexpected to raise; reconciliation simply ignores its empty output.\n\nRun: `python apps/cli/ingest_vhm.py --start 2025-04-30 --end 2026-04-29`.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sys\nfrom datetime import date, timedelta\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport click\n\nfrom packages.contracts import Ticker\nfrom packages.infrastructure.market_data import (\n    ReconciledBar,\n    ReconciliationConfidence,\n    ReconciliationService,\n    SqliteBarRepository,\n    SsiAdapter,\n    SsiApiError,\n    TcbsAdapter,\n    TcbsApiError,\n    VnstockAdapter,\n    VnstockAdapterError,\n)\n\n\ndef _ensure_utf8_stdout() -> None:\n    \"\"\"Reconfigure stdout to UTF-8 so vnstock's Vietnamese banner does not\n    UnicodeEncodeError under Windows cp1252. Called from `main` before the\n    first VnstockAdapter construction (which lazily imports vnstock).\n    \"\"\"\n    _reconfigure = getattr(sys.stdout, \"reconfigure\", None)\n    if callable(_reconfigure):\n        _reconfigure(encoding=\"utf-8\")\n\n\n@click.command()\n@click.option(\"--ticker\", default=\"VHM\", show_default=True)\n@click.option(\"--start\", default=None, help=\"ISO date; default = end - 365 days\")\n@click.option(\"--end\", default=None, help=\"ISO date; default = today\")\n@click.option(\n    \"--output\",\n    default=\"./data/vhm.sqlite\",\n    show_default=True,\n    type=click.Path(dir_okay=False, path_type=Path),\n)\n@click.option(\"--report\", default=None, type=click.Path(dir_okay=False, path_type=Path))\ndef main(ticker: str, start: str | None, end: str | None, output: Path, report: Path | None) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Ingest a year of VHM (default) DAILY bars; reconcile vnstock vs TCBS.\"\"\"\n    _ensure_utf8_stdout()\n    end_date = date.fromisoformat(end) if end else date.today()\n    start_date = date.fromisoformat(start) if start else end_date - timedelta(days=365)\n    report_path = report if report is not None else output.with_name(output.stem + \"-reconciliation.md\")\n    t = Ticker(ticker)\n\n    click.echo(f\"[ingest_vhm] ticker={t.symbol} window={start_date}..{end_date}\")\n    click.echo(f\"[ingest_vhm] output={output} report={report_path}\")\n\n    vnstock_adapter = VnstockAdapter()\n    tcbs_adapter = TcbsAdapter()\n    reconciler = ReconciliationService()\n    repo = SqliteBarRepository(db_path=output)\n\n    try:\n        vnstock_bars = vnstock_adapter.fetch_daily(t, start_date, end_date)\n        click.echo(f\"[ingest_vhm] vnstock returned {len(vnstock_bars)} bars\")\n    except VnstockAdapterError as exc:\n        click.echo(f\"[ingest_vhm] vnstock FAILED: {exc}\", err=True)\n        return 2\n\n    try:\n        tcbs_bars = tcbs_adapter.fetch_daily(t, start_date, end_date)\n        click.echo(f\"[ingest_vhm] tcbs returned {len(tcbs_bars)} bars\")\n    except TcbsApiError as exc:\n        click.echo(f\"[ingest_vhm] tcbs unavailable, single-source mode: {exc}\", err=True)\n        tcbs_bars = []\n\n    written = repo.save_many(list(vnstock_bars) + list(tcbs_bars))\n    click.echo(f\"[ingest_vhm] wrote {written} rows; total in db = {repo.count()}\")\n\n    reconciled = reconciler.reconcile(vnstock_bars, tcbs_bars)\n    _write_report(report_path, t, start_date, end_date, reconciled)\n    click.echo(f\"[ingest_vhm] reconciliation report written: {report_path}\")\n    click.echo(\"[ingest_vhm] OK\")\n    return 0\n\n\ndef _write_report(\n    path: Path,\n    ticker: Ticker,\n    start: date,\n    end: date,\n    rows: list[ReconciledBar],\n) -> None:\n    high = sum(1 for r in rows if r.confidence == ReconciliationConfidence.HIGH)\n    low = sum(1 for r in rows if r.confidence == ReconciliationConfidence.LOW)\n    single = sum(1 for r in rows if r.confidence == ReconciliationConfidence.SINGLE_SOURCE)\n    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    lines: list[str] = [\n        f\"# Reconciliation Report — {ticker.symbol}\",\n        \"\",\n        f\"**Window**: {start} → {end}\",\n        f\"**Total rows**: {len(rows)}\",\n        f\"- HIGH (within 1%): {high}\",\n        f\"- LOW (>1% divergence): {low}\",\n        f\"- SINGLE_SOURCE: {single}\",\n        \"\",\n        \"## Sample divergences (LOW)\",\n        \"\",\n    ]\n    samples = [r for r in rows if r.confidence == ReconciliationConfidence.LOW][:5]\n    if not samples:\n        lines.append(\"(none)\")\n    else:\n        for r in samples:\n            closes = {k.value: str(v.amount) for k, v in r.close_by_source.items()}\n            lines.append(f\"- {r.period_end}: divergence={r.divergence_pct} closes={closes}\")\n    path.write_text(\"\\n\".join(lines) + \"\\n\", encoding=\"utf-8\")\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    sys.exit(main(standalone_mode=False) or 0)\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":69,"oldLines":6,"newStart":69,"newLines":7,"lines":[" dict[str, object]:\n        n = len(t_epochs)\n        return {\n            \"code\": \"SUCCESS\",\n            \"message\": \"ok\",\n            \"data\": {\n                \"t\": list(t_epochs),\n                \"o\": [c - 0.5 for c in closes],\n                \"h\": [c + 0.3 for c in closes],\n                \"l\": [c - 0.7 for c in closes],\n                \"c\": list(closes),\n                \"v\": [1_000_000 + i for i in range(n)],\n                \"s\": \"ok\",\n                \"nextTime\": None,\n            },\n        }\n\n    def test_fetch_maps_payload_to_bars_thousand_vnd(self) -> None:\n        # 2026-04-28 UTC midnight, 2026-04-29 UTC midnight\n        t1 = int(datetime(2026, 4, 28, tzinfo=UTC).timestamp())\n        t2 = int(datetime(2026, 4, 29, tzinfo=UTC).timestamp())\n        payload = self._payload([t1, t2], [123.5, 124.0])\n        bars = self._adapter(_FakeResponse(200, payload)).fetch_daily(\n            Ticker(\"VHM\"), date(2026, 4, 1), date(2026, 4, 30)\n        )\n        assert len(bars) == 2\n        # thousand-VND multiplier (123.5 → 123500)\n        assert bars[0].close.amount == Decimal(\"123500.0\")\n        assert bars[0].source_provider == SourceProvider.SSI\n        assert bars[0].adjustment_type == AdjustmentType.BOTH\n        assert bars[0].volume == 1_000_000\n\n    def test_non_200_raises_SsiApiError(self) -> None:\n        with pytest.raises(SsiApiError, match=\"status\"):\n            self._adapter(_FakeResponse(503, {})).fetch_daily(\n                Ticker(\"VHM\"), date(2026, 4, 1), date(2026, 4, 30)\n            )\n\n    def test_unexpected_payload_shape_raises(self) -> None:\n        with pytest.raises(SsiApiError, match=\"payload shape\"):\n            self._adapter(_FakeResponse(200, [\"not\", \"a\", \"dict\"])).fetch_daily(\n                Ticker(\"VHM\"), date(2026, 4, 1), date(2026, 4, 30)\n            )\n\n    def test_missing_data_key_raises(self) -> None:\n        with pytest.raises(SsiApiError, match=\"payload shape\"):\n            self._adapter(_FakeResponse(200, {\"code\": \"SUCCESS\"})).fetch_daily(\n                Ticker(\"VHM\"), date(2026, 4, 1), date(2026, 4, 30)\n            )\n\n    def test_data_not_dict_raises(self) -> None:\n        with pytest.raises(SsiApiError, match=\"data shape\"):\n            self._adapter(_FakeResponse(200, {\"data\": \"string-not-dict\"})).fetch_daily(\n                Ticker(\"VHM\"), date(2026, 4, 1), date(2026, 4, 30)\n            )\n\n    def test_array_length_mismatch_raises(self) -> None:\n        bad = {\n            \"data\": {\n                \"t\": [1, 2, 3],\n                \"o\": [1.0, 2.0],\n                \"h\": [1.0, 2.0, 3.0],\n                \"l\": [1.0, 2.0, 3.0],\n                \"c\": [1.0, 2.0, 3.0],\n                \"v\": [1, 2, 3],\n            }\n        }\n        with pytest.raises(SsiApiError, match=\"length mismatch\"):\n            self._adapter(_FakeResponse(200, bad)).fetch_daily(\n                Ticker(\"VHM\"), date(2026, 4, 1), date(2026, 4, 30)\n            )\n\n    def test_filters_outside_range(self) -> None:\n        early = int(datetime(2026, 1, 15, tzinfo=UTC).timestamp())\n        inside = int(datetime(2026, 4, 15, tzinfo=UTC).timestamp())\n        payload = self._payload([early, inside], [100.0, 120.0])\n        bars = self._adapter(_FakeResponse(200, payload)).fetch_daily(\n            Ticker(\"VHM\"), date(2026, 4, 1), date(2026, 4, 30)\n        )\n        assert len(bars) == 1\n        assert bars[0].period_end == date(2026, 4, 15)\n\n    def test_invalid_start_after_end(self) -> None:\n        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match=\"start\"):\n            self._adapter(_FakeResponse(200, {\"data\": {}})).fetch_daily(\n                Ticker(\"VHM\"), date(2026, 4, 30), date(2026, 4, 1)\n            )\n\n    def test_empty_data_returns_empty_list(self) -> None:\n        payload: dict[str, object] = {\"data\": {\"t\": [], \"o\": [], \"h\": [], \"l\": [], \"c\": [], \"v\": []}}\n        bars = self._adapter(_FakeResponse(200, payload)).fetch_daily(\n            Ticker(\"VHM\"), date(2026, 4, 1), date(2026, 4, 30)\n        )\n        assert bars == []\n\n    def test_bars_sorted_ascending_by_period_end(self) -> None:\n        # supply unsorted timestamps; adapter must sort ascending\n        t_late = int(datetime(2026, 4, 29, tzinfo=UTC).timestamp())\n        t_mid = int(datetime(2026, 4, 28, tzinfo=UTC).timestamp())\n        t_early = int(datetime(2026, 4, 27, tzinfo=UTC).timestamp())\n        payload = self._payload([t_late, t_early, t_mid], [124.0, self._adapter(_FakeResponse(200, payload)).fetch_daily(\n            Ticker(\"VHM\"), date(2026, 4, 1), date(2026, 4, 30)\n        )\n        assert all(b.source_provider == SourceProvider.SSI for b in bars)\n\n    def test_volume_coerced_to_int(self) -> None:\n        t = int(datetime(2026, 4, 28, tzinfo=UTC).timestamp())\n        payload = {\"data\": {\"t\": [t], \"o\": [1.0], \"h\": [1.0], \"l\": [1.0], \"c\": [1.0], \"v\": [4570000.0]}}\n        bars = self._adapter(_FakeResponse(200, payload)).fetch_daily(\n            Ticker(\"VHM\"), date(2026, 4, 1), date(2026, 4, 30)\n        )\n tzinfo=UTC).timestamp())\n        payload = self._payload([t], [41.15])\n        bars = self._adapter(_FakeResponse(200, payload)).fetch_daily(\n            Ticker(\"VHM\"), date(2026, 4, 1), date(2026, 4, 30)\n        )\n        assert bars[0].close.amount == Decimal(\"41150.00\")  # 41.15 * 1000\n        assert bars[0].close.currency == Currency.VND\n\n\n# \"\"\"Verify VnstockAdapter (VCI) + SsiAdapter (iBoard) yield reconcilable Bars.\"\"\"\n\n    def test_vci_vs_ssi_within_tolerance_HIGH(self) -> None:\n        d = date(2026, 4, 28)\n        vci = [_bar(period_end=d, close_amount=\"100000\", source=SourceProvider.VNSTOCK)]\n        ssi = [_bar(period_end=d, close_amount=\"100500\", source=SourceProvider.SSI)]\n        rows = ReconciliationService().reconcile(vci, ssi)\n        assert len(rows) == 1\n        assert rows[0].confidence == ReconciliationConfidence.HIGH\n        assert rows[0].sources_present == date(2026, 4, 28)\n        rows = ReconciliationService().reconcile(\n            [_bar(period_end=d, source=SourceProvider.VNSTOCK)], []\n        )\n        assert rows[0].confidence == ReconciliationConfidence.SINGLE_SOURCE\n        assert rows[0].sources_present == (SourceProvider.VNSTOCK,)\n\n    def test_ssi_only_emits_SINGLE_SOURCE_SSI(self) -> None:\n        d = date(2026, 4, 28)\n        rows = ReconciliationService().reconcile(\n            [], [_bar(period_end=d, source=SourceProvider.SSI)]\n        )\n        assert rows[0].confidence == ReconciliationConfidence.SINGLE_SOURCE\n        assert rows[0].sources_present == (SourceProvider.SSI,)\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n#
